statistics.primary_metric: official Task-3 cF1; local dev scorer used for checkpoint selection must be identified
statistics.report: Each seed, mean, sample SD, paired seed deltas; paired example bootstrap 10000 resamples seed 20260907. For seed-mean contrast resample same examples across all seeds and average per-seed cF1 differences; distinguish example CI from training-seed variability.
statistics.multiplicity: Holm correction across six confirmatory dataset-by-contrast tests; report unadjusted 95% CI and adjusted p, not conflated significance. Macro over fixed 3 datasets descriptive; no generalization to all languages.
statistics.coverage: Report discrete extraction F1, matched V/A MAE and matched coverage; explicit/implicit sample counts; all planned outcomes including negative results.

p_value_definition: Two-sided centered paired bootstrap: (1 + count(abs(bootstrap_delta-observed_delta) >= abs(observed_delta)))/(10000+1); Holm over six test contrasts separately from dev.
